title: BROOD DataOps extraction contract
provenance: first pass. i opened the first few tabs of each june file and wrote down what i saw. this is not finished, i still have to look at every tab.

conventions.text_normalisation: trim, collapse spaces inside, uppercase. that is all.
conventions.blank_cell_semantics: a blank qty cell means not recorded. it is not 0 and it is not data.
conventions.numeric_rule: excel numbers as they are. text has to be digits or it becomes non_numeric_qty.
conventions.date_rule: the day comes from the tab name, the month and year from this contract.
conventions.dup_policy_day_grid: first row wins for a (date, product, branch) key.
